title: Secure leaderboard.ts - fix userId lookups
description: Fix leaderboard.ts to properly look up user data using userId, not email as visitorId. This is the main bug causing shared data between users.

acceptanceCriteria.text: getUserInfo: Query users table by auth user ID, not visitorId
getStreakLeaderboard: Use userId to look up practice data, not email
getProgressLeaderboard: Use userId to look up word/line progress, not email
getUserRank: Use ctx.auth for current user, not visitorId argument
setDisplayName: Use requireAuth, not visitorId argument
Remove all visitorId arguments from exported functions
